item.title: How Rate Limiting Handles Traffic Bursts: Windows, Leaky Buckets, and Token Buckets
item.description: Rate limiting controls the number or rate of requests admitted into a system, preventing traffic bursts from exhausting threads, connections, and database processing capacity.

item.title: The Method to Manage Traffic
item.description: Do you know the basic method to manage the traffic? There are four methods: Load Balancers, Reverse Proxies, Forward Proxies, and API Gateways. And they have different features and usage scenarios.
